scope: Only original diocesan-source-labelled records, not a change to the worldwide venue master
policy: Institution/confraternity operator identity is distinct from diocesan jurisdiction; keep all existing pins provisional and all photo rights unresolved. In particular, the name Oratory does NOT imply a religious institute.

decisions.name: Oratory of S.s. Pietro and Caterina
decisions.reason: Savona visitor authority and Liguria regional itinerary identify the present Ss Pietro e Caterina oratory as the confraternity's seat; retain current mapped marker as unassessed.

decisions.name: Oratorio dei Bianchi
decisions.reason: Geocoded site is Rapallo's Oratorio dei Bianchi, not a similarly named oratory elsewhere; municipal metropolitan source locates it in Vico della Rosa; the confraternity remains active.

decisions.name: Oratorium Heiliger Vierzehn Nothelfer (Oratory of the Fourteen Holy Helpers)
decisions.reason: SSPX's own 24 July 2026 liturgical event explicitly identifies its chapel at Semmelstrasse 12, Wurzburg. The inherited coordinate is not independently checked as the chapel footprint.

decisions.name: The Oratory of Ss. Gregory and Augustine
decisions.reason: The oratory's official About Us explicitly states it is uniquely administered by priests of the Archdiocese of St Louis. It has met since 2018 at St Luke the Evangelist church, 7230 Dale Ave; its inherited pin still needs exact building verification.

decisions.name: St Clement Oratory
decisions.reason: The Diocese of Bismarck lists St Clement Oratory under its own parish finder, says oversight transferred to the diocese in 2017, and regulates its traditional Mass in the 2021 diocesan decree. It is at Haymarsh (Glen Ullin postal area), not necessarily in Glen Ullin town; inherited point remains unassessed.

decisions.name: Chapel of the Order of the Carmelite Sisters
decisions.reason: The source label's Ełk Carmelite Sisters chapel matches the Discalced Carmelite nuns' own account of their Wityny monastery chapel, built and dedicated for the community. Do not treat the priest who celebrates Mass there as the chapel operator or claim exact chapel footprint.
